lines.1: 「Good. You managed to get up. Well done.」
lines.3: 「I will guide you to the washroom. There are stairs, after all.」
lines.8: 「Dry yourself properly. Here, give it to me.」
lines.10: When the towel left my face, Otome's smile filled my vision.
lines.11: 「Yes. Now you look like the usual Leo.」
lines.12: The television was on in the living room.
lines.13: 「You said you would not need a packed lunch today, correct?」
lines.15: 「The start of the rainy season still appears some way off for Kanto-Koshinetsu.」
lines.17: 「Rain is necessary, but I dislike that damp, oppressive feeling.」
lines.18: 「The weather forecast is over. May I change the channel?」
lines.20: I was curious which channel she would choose.
lines.22: The narrator was saying something about evil never ceasing, no matter the age.
lines.23: 「Hearing this theme before school puts me in the proper frame of mind for disciplinary-committee duty.」
lines.25: And, naturally, breakfast was rice balls.
